nodes.label: Canonical Operation Order: link → analyse → approve → profile
nodes.rationale: Operating approve-then-link caused the system to correctly invalidate 19 fresh approvals, because `confirmedSpecifications` feeds Confirmed requirement links into the Understanding input and the 68 links shifted the input fingerprint, marking approvals REVALIDATION_REQUIRED. Reverse order is safe but wasteful; the efficient order should be encoded in the operator runbook so the re-analysis churn is not repeated.

nodes.label: Why the Terminal Condition Is GOVERNED HOLD
nodes.rationale: Every automated stage that can run without a human decision was run to a stable verified fixed point. The remainder — understanding review, standards, compatibility target, product family, readiness approval — must not be auto-resolved, impersonated, or inferred from web knowledge.

nodes.label: Governed System-Auto-Approval Policy
nodes.rationale: The pure policy gates approval on deterministic reproducibility — family/category exactly reproducible from raw text, system confirmed by deterministic section context, only `detector_technology` EXTRACTED, no unverified manufacturer/standards/compatibility claims — NEVER AI confidence. Items that 'declined' with only positive reasons were hitting the idempotency guard (409 UNDERSTANDING_REVIEW_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT).

nodes.label: Deterministic Requirement-Applicability Linker (suggest-links)
nodes.rationale: 630 active links, 68 auto-confirmed deterministically on exact-equipment + category + approved-downstream requirement, actor 'Requirement Applicability Engine' — the governed path, not AI confidence.

nodes.label: Phase 6 Taxonomy Repairs (Strobe/Sounder conjunction; fireman telephone jack)
nodes.rationale: Two real defects repaired at the canonical governed taxonomy with regression tests and no Golden special cases: the Sounder/Strobe alias list owned only the 'sounder (with) strobe' conjunction and not the inverted 'strobe with sounder' form; and 'fireman' was missing from the alias list, the requirement vocabulary and the fire-service-context regex. The first also prevented auto-approval from ratifying the wrong family.

nodes.label: NO_PRODUCT_FAMILY (function without hardware identity)
nodes.rationale: The governed taxonomy classifies the 12 non-analyzed Lump Sum interface/control functions as function without hardware identity, legitimately outside product Understanding and outside purchasable quotation. Web research corroborates the reading: NFPA 72 Ch. 21.3 emergency-control interfaces are system functions, not separately purchased devices.

nodes.label: SBC 801 (Saudi Fire Code) as Governing Code
nodes.rationale: For a Saudi school the governing fire code is SBC 801, which references and is substantially based on NFPA 72; enforcement is by Saudi Civil Defense (GDCD), which expects SBC 801-compliant submissions such as structured cause-and-effect matrices. SBC 801 has independent legal standing and is not a wholesale adoption of NFPA 72.

nodes.label: NFPA 72 (National Fire Alarm and Signaling Code)
G10 Combined Smoke + Heat Device Intent
nodes.rationale: Whether a combined multi-sensor device is required is a specification/standards question for the engineer against the governing document — not a value the pipeline may assert.

nodes.label: Authority Hierarchy (project evidence → AHJ → NFPA/UL/EN/IEC/BS → certification → manufacturer → precedent)
nodes.rationale: Web research establishes only the reference frame for the engineer's decision; none of it is auto-promoted into a Project Requirement and it is presented for human adjudication only.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Constraint Restore (migration 0011)
nodes.rationale: A hand-authored forward migration restored the two NOT NULL constraints that migration 0010's table rebuild had lost in the live chain, while preserving 2 CHECKs and 2 FKs; applied live and proven outcome-idempotent.
